topic: Giza, Egypt, around 2560 BCE: the Great Pyramid was built from over two million stone blocks and was the tallest human-made structure for about 3,800 years.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: The Giant of Giza

shots.narration: One sparkling jump—and something enormous hides behind the dust!
shots.scene: Sunlit desert at Giza, Egypt; swirling dust conceals a towering pyramid, cinematic 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock materialize together in golden time-jump sparkles.
shots.mood: Brilliant blue watch glow, golden particles, welcoming adventure.

shots.narration: We're in Giza, Egypt, around 2560 BCE.
shots.scene: Sandy ground beside massive pale stone blocks at the Great Pyramid, bright sunlight, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya shades her eyes with one hand.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, enormous stone surfaces, curious anticipation.

shots.scene: Close beside the Great Pyramid's base, its stone face extends beyond the upper frame, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya tilts her head far backward.
shots.mood: Playful bewilderment beneath a towering wall of sunlit stone.

shots.narration: We're too close to see the whole pyramid!
shots.scene: Narrow upward view beside the Great Pyramid, clear blue sky above pale stone, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Tock leans backward on his tiny legs.
shots.mood: Gentle visual comedy, shiny brass, bright desert light.

shots.narration: Zoya spots open ground farther away.
shots.scene: Broad flat sandy clearing extending away from the Great Pyramid, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya points toward the open clearing.
shots.mood: Clear inviting space, warm sand, hopeful discovery.

shots.narration: [excited] A little distance might reveal a giant!
shots.scene: Level sandy ground leading away from the Great Pyramid, ancient Giza beneath blue sky, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock walk together into the clearing.
shots.mood: Bouncy friendly movement, sunlit dust, growing anticipation.

shots.narration: The Great Pyramid was built from over two million stone blocks.
shots.scene: Detailed close view of fitted stone blocks on the Great Pyramid, pale textured surfaces in golden sunlight, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: A thin veil of windblown dust drifts across the stonework.
shots.mood: Tactile stone textures, immense scale, quiet wonder.

shots.narration: Now its whole shape comes into view.
shots.scene: Wide clear view of the complete Great Pyramid from flat sandy ground, tiny travelers in the foreground, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the pyramid.
shots.mood: Triumphant reveal, radiant sunlight, immense triangular silhouette.

shots.narration: [surprised] It remained the tallest human-made structure for about 3,800 years.
shots.scene: The Great Pyramid rises above Zoya and Tock across the sunlit clearing, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Tock tips his round glass face upward.
shots.mood: Awe-filled stillness, gleaming brass, towering pale stone.

shots.narration: Their tiny shadows make the giant look even bigger.
shots.scene: Zoya and Tock stand on flat sand before the complete Great Pyramid, distinct shadows beneath them, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya looks down at their shadows.
shots.mood: Gentle amusement, warm light, satisfying sense of scale.

shots.narration: One last look, then another leap through time.
shots.scene: Open clearing facing the Great Pyramid, blue watch light spilling across Zoya's yellow sleeve, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya presses her glowing blue wristwatch.
shots.mood: Golden sparkles gathering, affectionate farewell, fresh anticipation.

shots.scene: Giza's Great Pyramid behind the travelers, a halo of blue light and golden time-travel sparkles, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Tock turns his round glass face toward Zoya.
shots.mood: Bright curious expressions, magical glow, inviting cliffhanger.

episode.endHook: The blue watch glows again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock sparkle into Giza, Egypt, around 2560 BCE. A blocked view becomes a little adventure as they discover the Great Pyramid’s enormous scale and remarkable history.
